summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AirYatra helicopter charter platform. Fixed critical backend ObjectId serialization issue and frontend HTTPS API configuration. Backend APIs are working well with 85.7% success rate. Frontend loads correctly with professional aviation design, user registration/login works, but booking integration has mixed content security issues that were resolved.

critical_bugs.issue: Missing pydantic-settings dependency causing server startup failure
MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in JWT token response
AI service and operator notification causing ObjectId serialization errors

routing_issues.issue: FastAPI redirecting POST /api/bookings to GET /api/bookings/ causing 307->403 errors
routing_issues.impact: API calls failing due to method change in redirect

integration_issues.issue: Mixed content error - frontend making HTTP requests instead of HTTPS
integration_issues.impact: All API calls blocked by browser security

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Failed to load bookings' error initially due to API issues

passed_tests: User registration with JWT token generation
Get user profile with JWT validation
Landing page loads with professional aviation design
